method: Check for a diamond with five distinct target labels. In its absence, for h>=4 any simple representative graph has at most floor(h^2/4) edges. Every vertex outside a triangle has at most one neighbor inside it. Induct on deleting the three vertices, with the triangle-free case given by Mantel. Use only if strictly stronger than the K4-free ceiling. Return UNKNOWN on unresolved infinite families. Start with two independent frozen panels of 16. Verify against direct labelled small-graph enumeration before use.
